_comment: plan-generic-kill-quests.md C1 — the Farmer's kill quest, filling the L2 gap between turnip-chore (harvest, L1) and wolves-on-the-road (kill, L3). Target measured: 10 Boar L2 spawns within 6-14 units of the Farmer at (-57.0, 28.6). Reward on the turn-in row (farmer.json): 180 XP = the L9 half-level rule at L2 (0.5 x 300 x 1.2^1). Second quest on the same giver — the first NPC to carry two offers. Text deliberately plain (PO 2026-08-02: no lore or stylized quest text yet).
